svg.data-weight-note: 98 lb (44.45 kg) with power supplies and fans installed, 76 lb (34.47 kg) chassis only (guide Table 32)
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 GbE and 40 GbE; 4 x 25 GbE on ports 0, 4, 8 to 124 (guide, Port Configurations)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic. Typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic (guide Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 19.36 A at 100 to 127 VAC, 10.95 A at 200 to 240 VAC (guide Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating -40 to -72 VDC, 40 A maximum (guide Table 26)
svg.data-redundancy-note: four supplies, 2+2. The switch can run on two supplies if one is in slot 0 or 1 and the other in slot 2 or 3
svg.data-fans: six fan modules of two fans each, (5x2+1)+1; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-airflow-note: AFO only, front-to-back (port-to-FRU); the 128C is not sold with back-to-front airflow
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C (guide Table 31)
svg.data-software: Junos OS Evolved, first release 19.2R1 (the guide names it the QFX5200-128C at that point)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE QSFP28 and DAC, QSFP28 to SFP28 breakout DAC, 100 GbE AOC, 40 GbE QSFP+ and DAC (guide, Network Ports)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: ports 128 and 129 take SFP+ modules at 10 GbE (the guide also says 1 GbE; see gaps)
svg.data-ptp: clock input and output connectors for 10 MHz and 1 PPS, and an RJ-45 time-of-day port
svg.data-timing-outputs: PPS and 10 MHz clock connectors, in and out, and an RJ-45 time-of-day port
svg.data-safety: CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1; UL 62368-1; IEC 62368-1:2014; IEC 60950-1:2005/A2:2013 (CB scheme); EN 60825-1 (guide, Agency Approvals for the QFX Series)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A. EN 55022 Class A. VCCI Class A. BSMI CNS 13438 Class A. AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A. EN 55024. CISPR 24. EN 300 386. EN 61000-3-2. EN 61000-3-3. (guide, Agency Approvals for the QFX Series)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 31)
